appears.news: Now the downstairs toilet rocks when you sit on it. And the floor around it is damp.

surprises.title: Closet bolts rust solid
surprises.description: The toilet bolts are rusted into one solid lump of sadness.

options.text: Twist until something gives
Replace the whole bathroom floor
Cut them with a mini hacksaw

surprises.title: Flange breaks
surprises.description: The flange crumbles like a stale cookie when you lift the toilet.

options.text: Replace the drain line under the floor
Install a flange repair ring
Stack two wax rings

surprises.title: Subfloor is rotten
surprises.description: Around the drain, the subfloor is spongy. The old toilet has been leaking quietly for years.

options.text: Cut out and replace the rotten section
Set the toilet on a plywood shim
Replace the whole bathroom subfloor

surprises.title: Joist rot appears
surprises.description: From below, the joist under the toilet is dark and soft.

options.text: Sister the joist
Soak it in wood hardener
Reframe the bathroom floor

surprises.title: Rough-in is odd
surprises.description: The drain is 10 inches from the wall. Your new toilet needs 12.

options.text: Return it for a 10-inch rough-in toilet
Use an offset flange
Move the drain

surprises.title: Shutoff starts dripping
surprises.description: You turn the toilet shutoff, and now it drips from the stem.

options.text: Repipe the bathroom
Tighten the packing nut
Replace the shutoff valve

surprises.title: Wax ring leaks
surprises.description: First flush. A little puddle forms around the base. Not ideal.

options.text: Pull the toilet and reset with a new ring
Buy a different toilet
Caulk around the base to hold it in

surprises.title: Toilet rocks
surprises.description: The new toilet rocks side to side like a boat. The floor isn't level.

options.text: Level the whole bathroom floor
Shim it with plastic shims and caulk
Crank the bolts until it stops

surprises.title: Floor tiles crack
surprises.description: Removing the old toilet cracked two tiles, and the new base is smaller.

options.text: Retile the whole bathroom
Replace the cracked tiles
Pick a toilet with a bigger footprint

surprises.title: Sewer smell lingers
surprises.description: A faint sewer smell hangs around after the install. Something isn't sealed.

options.text: Light a candle and move on
Replace the main stack
Check the seal and the vent

surprises.title: Ceiling below stains
surprises.description: Downstairs, there's a brown ring on the ceiling right under the toilet.

options.text: Open a small section, dry it, and patch
Paint over the stain
Replace the whole ceiling

surprises.title: Tank bolt snaps
surprises.description: One tank bolt snaps while you're tightening it. Porcelain is not forgiving.

options.text: Buy a new toilet
Glue the tank to the bowl
Install a new tank bolt kit

surprises.title: Vanity looks old
surprises.description: Next to the sparkly new toilet, the vanity looks like it survived a flood. It may have.

options.text: Paint it with leftover wall paint
Add it to the list
Replace the vanity and faucet today

surprises.title: Bidet seat tempts you
surprises.description: The store has a fancy bidet seat with a heated seat and a nightlight.

options.text: Run an extension cord across the floor for it
Buy it later once the toilet is settled
Get a smart toilet with an app

surprises.title: Partner complains about fan
surprises.description: Your partner: "While you're in there, the bathroom fan sounds like a jet engine."

options.text: Turn off the fan breaker forever
Clean the fan grille for now
Replace the fan and duct today

video.title: Replace a toilet the right way

ask.question: How do I replace a toilet?
ask.answer: Easy one! 1. Lift off the old toilet. 2. Set the new one. 3. Tighten the bolts!
ask.skipped: It skipped shutting off the water and the new wax ring.
